- From thread: Ops (view A) means a new booking when the carrier or lane changes; a same-carrier, same-lane date or window change is AMENDED.

- From thread: Ops (view A) means “waiting on customer.”

- From thread: Finance means a credit hold on the account, where nothing ships.
